Great question! Here's how to set up your Eco Organic Mattress the first time:
Unboxing (do this within 30 days of delivery):
Open the shipping box at the top
Lay the box on its side and slide the mattress out
Remove the outer wrap (Kraft paper or white plastic)
Unroll the mattress and place it on your bed frame or foundation — don't cut the inner plastic yet
Carefully cut and remove the inner vacuum-seal layer — the mattress will immediately start expanding (it's fun to watch!)
Expansion timeline:
Within 30 minutes: Close to full size and ready to sleep on
Within 3-5 hours: Full expansion (you can lift each corner and give it a gentle shake to help)
Within a few days: Any wrinkles in the cover will smooth out naturally
Before your first night:
Put your mattress protector on right away — this is really important. If the mattress gets stained without a protector, you won't be able to return it during your trial period.
What to expect:
You'll notice a fresh, natural scent when you first open it (not chemical off-gassing) — that will dissipate soon. The mattress might feel firmer than expected at first, which is normal for organic latex.

Here's the return policy for the Eco Organic Mattress:
100-day sleep trial
You have 100 nights to try the mattress at home. The trial starts the day you receive it.
30-day minimum use required
You must use the mattress for at least 30 days before you can request a return — this gives your body time to adjust to the new support. Returns aren't accepted before completing this adjustment period.
Return window
After the 30-day minimum, you can request a return anytime up until day 100. Contact support@avocadomattress.com to get a Return Authorization and arrange the return.
Return fee and refund
There's a $99 return fee per mattress. After the return is reviewed and received, you'll get a full refund minus that $99 fee. The refund goes back to your original payment method. Any shipping or delivery fees you paid are non-refundable.
Important condition
You need to use a mattress protector and keep the mattress in good condition (no stains or damage). Photographic documentation will be required and reviewed. Returned mattresses are donated, never resold.
Bottom line: You have over 3 months to decide, but you need to give it at least a month first. That's a pretty safe window for a first-timer!
